method: ARRIVAL (explicit | implicit | negative) x QUESTION kind (logic | UI). Positives are one named design question that throwaway code can answer; negatives are building the real thing (tdd-dev), a reproducible bug (bugfix), a decision with no code question (architecture) and a vague idea with no question yet (grill).
